title_en: APARTMENT 2+1+3+2 PARKING POST NEAR THE DRY LAKE
description_en: Offered for sale is an apartment l2+1+3+2 parking spaces l with an area of ​​239 m², located in one of the most preferred and quiet areas of Tirana, at Dry Lake. The apartment is characterized by a modern and high-quality furniture, with a very functional organization: Large living room with an unobstructed view of the lake Separate kitchen 2 comfortable bedrooms 3 bathrooms Dedicated laundry 2 parking spaces Ample spaces, natural lighting and a relaxing view of the lake make this property ideal for a comfortable and elite lifestyle. 📍 Quiet and highly sought after area 🌅 Open and relaxing view For more information or to visit the property, contact us.
